status: frozen after the public-data inventory and before constructing any dynamical-stress feature or reading any dynamical-feature score
purpose: Determine whether independently measured baryonic random stress carries transferable information about the spent cluster Weyl residual that static local and boundary baryon fields did not carry.

sample.target_interpretation: same-catalog conventional halo reconstruction used only as a spent inverse target, not direct truth

physical_question.postulate: The gravitational source information may depend on the full coarse-grained baryonic stress-energy tensor rather than rest-mass density alone. Coherent bulk motion belongs to the local Landau-frame velocity, whereas thermal and multistream motion remains as spatial stress.
physical_question.covariant_diagnostic: Let u^mu be the timelike Landau eigenvector of T_b^{mu nu}, h_mu_nu=g_mu_nu+u_mu u_nu, rho_b=T_b^{mu nu}u_mu u_nu/c^2, and S_mu_nu=h_mu_alpha h_nu_beta T_b^{alpha beta}. The dimensionless random-stress invariant is Theta_b=sqrt(S_mu_nu S^{mu nu})/(rho_b c^2).
physical_question.projected_member_proxy: q_member(x)=sum_i kappa_i(x) [v_los_i-vbar_los(x)]^2/c^2 using only secure spectroscopic members and a universal declared kernel
physical_question.interpretation_limit: The projected proxies test source information only. Their inverse coefficients are not physical constants, and a passing pattern would still require a healthy covariant action.

feature_families.static_baseline: the unchanged five-scale v16B internal baryon family
feature_families.thermal_total: static baseline plus one-potential E-mode triplets generated from q_gas at the frozen 25, 75, and 150 kpc scales
feature_families.thermal_component: thermal_total plus gas-only temperature contrast relative to the cluster-wide spectroscopic temperature; no shock label

stage_A_thermal_stress.advance_condition: Run only after both clusters satisfy every thermal requirement. A one-cluster temperature map is not sufficient for transfer selection.

feature_families.thermal_baseline: the frozen stage-A family without changing its coefficients or scales
feature_families.member_random_stress: thermal baseline plus one-potential E-mode triplets generated from q_member
feature_families.combined_random_stress: thermal baseline plus q_gas+q_member with no object-type gate or per-cluster normalization

stage_B_collisionless_member_stress.advance_condition: Do not run or rank stage B until both clusters meet the same member-stress requirements. PLCK G287 alone cannot select a formula.

frozen_fit_rule.selection: symmetric leave-one-cluster-out transfer on the spent pair

decision_rule: If stage A passes every gate, require the next action to generate a thermal-stress response from a universally coupled healthy field; do not promote an inverse coefficient to a gravity constant.
If stage A fails, reject resolved projected gas thermal stress at the available resolution as the missing transferable source, but do not claim to reject collisionless member stress.

If matched stage B passes every gate, require the next action to generate coarse-graining dynamically from a universal propagator or physical correlation length rather than an analyst-selected cluster scale.
If matched stage B fails, retire the tested instantaneous baryonic random-stress family and move to causal history or a materially different mechanism.
No spent-map outcome validates a theory or authorizes opening a holdout.
claim_boundary: The two comparator maps are spent and model-derived.
X-ray count morphology alone is not a temperature or pressure measurement.
Only line-of-sight velocities are observed; transverse stress and line-of-sight depth require disclosed projection assumptions.
The Landau-frame invariant is a source postulate, not yet an action or field equation.
Any matter-stress-dependent action must preserve universal metric coupling, diffeomorphism conservation, a bounded Hamiltonian, luminal tensor propagation, and Solar-System limits.
